scripts.test:components:local: vp test --config apps/website/vitest.browser.config.ts && vp test --config apps/extension/vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:local: vp run --no-cache website#build && vp run --no-cache extension#build:test && playwright test --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:local: vp run --no-cache website#build && vp run --no-cache extension#build:test && vp run --no-cache extension#build:poc-d0 && playwright test --config playwright.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:headless:local: vp run --no-cache extension#build:poc-d0 && playwright test --config playwright.headless.config.ts
scripts.test:experiments:local: vp run --no-cache extension#build:test && vp run --no-cache extension#build:poc-d0 && playwright test --config playwright.experiments.config.ts
scripts.build:poc: vp run extension#build:poc-d0 && vp run extension#build:poc-d1 && vp run extension#build:poc-d2
scripts.test:extension-manifest: vp run build:poc && vp run extension#test:manifest
scripts.deps: depcruise packages tests --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && depcruise apps/website --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config apps/website/tsconfig.deps.json && depcruise apps/extension --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config apps/extension/tsconfig.deps.json
scripts.duplication: jscpd --threshold 1 --fail-on-empty apps/website/src apps/extension/src packages/domain/src packages/bridge/src packages/brand/src
